unstuck_said.text: Filed issue "The cheapest feeless rail to benchmark the Zenon x402 POC against is Nano — 0 fee, no coin required to pay the network" on edgepillar/zenon-x402-poc. Acknowledged they already moved x402 to a feeless Zenon rail; framed Nano as the current lower bound — 0 fee single-block finality with no separate network asset to hold or gas to fund before the first payment, exact x402 scheme published and tested (@x402nano/exact). Offered the live Vend endpoint (extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/status, 0.0001 XNO, x402Version 2) as a concrete mainnet accept to benchmark against. 3b case: already bel
